   35| 
   36|         self.dim = dim

   40|         self.ef_construction = ef_construction
   41|         self.mL = 1.0 / math.log(M)     # level normalization: P(level >= L) = M^-L
   42|         self.neighbor_selection = neighbor_selection
   43|         self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
   44|         self._dist_batch, self._dist_pairwise = get_metric(metric)
